original_frozen_config.laya_precision: FP32 weights with BF16 autocast; native choice temperature for base
original_frozen_config.clef_precision: NF4 double-quantized backbone, BF16 compute and official joint decision head

training.loss: official GRPO noisy logits proper_reward(w_sph=.75,w_rps=1) plus CE coefficient 1
training.scheduler: cosine to 1e-6; exact ceil update count
training.checkpoint_selection: fourth final epoch, independent of formal evaluation
training.calibration: 300 reserved official train items, global choice temperature via official LBFGS, clamp [.5,5]

metrics.accuracy: argmax original option order; first index breaks ties
metrics.brier: mean per-item sum over classes of (p-y)^2; no division by k
metrics.nll: natural log, probability floor 1e-12; clipping count reported
metrics.ece: 15 equal-width bins on max option probability; last bin includes 1
metrics.macro_average: unweighted mean of the three dataset metrics
metrics.latency: single item tokenization, forward, probability decode and CUDA synchronization; excludes disk writes and model load
metrics.memory: 1-second sampled total device memory including other processes; torch allocated/reserved separately

original_frozen_config.invalid_output_policy: stop affected batch, preserve error, repair infrastructure with deviation log, rerun affected items; never substitute a model answer
original_frozen_config.random_baseline: analytical uniform probabilities; expected accuracy 1/k (no simulated random draw used as evidence)
secondary_analysis: uncalibrated base and fine-tuned metrics reconstructed from saved raw logits with T=1
paired dataset-stratified bootstrap 10000 repetitions seed 20261006; repeated normalized stems clustered within dataset
deterministic replay first three items per dataset plus highest-confidence disagreement
original_frozen_config.optional_models: Kev only if core completion and report reserve allow; Clef27B/Jev/additional fine-tuning/cross-domain/multimodal omitted
